subject: Post-call recap: Enterprisecorp stakeholder mapping & procurement exception request
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap: Enterprisecorp stakeholder mapping + procurement timeline

Rishi / Vivek —

Quick recap from this afternoon's discovery with Sara (engineering lead) and Tom (procurement lead) at Enterprisecorp. High-level: they like our latency/cost profile and the idea of Dedicated for predictable throughput, but their buying process is slow and requires an exception to standard procurement terms for both pricing and SLA. Key notes: 

- Economic buyer: CFO (not on call) but Sara says executive sponsor is CTO (Priya Rao).
- Security/legal: they require a short security questionnaire + SOC2 Type II evidence. Their security team is willing to accept our standard SOC2 report but want an explicit data retention SLA in the contract.
- Procurement: Tom is procurement contact; they typically require 60-day PO cycles, but they have a hard go-live date of 2026-04-15 for a pilot.
- Decision criteria: latency at p95 < 700ms, unit cost below $0.0025/token for the pilot volume, and clear rollback/fallback policy.

As discussed on the call, procurement is asking for: (1) a one-time pilot discount to meet their budget, and (2) a 99.9% SLA on inference availability for Dedicated during the pilot. Both are exceptions to our standard terms. They asked if we can fast-track legal/security review to meet procurement timing.

Ask for you both: can we get an internal procurement exception approval to offer:
- Pilot discount: 20% off list for a 3-month pilot (estimated $45k ARR run-rate during pilot)
- SLA: 99.8% (we said we can consider 99.9% but want to confirm risk)

I attached the formal procurement-exception request doc and the updated pricing sheet they asked for. Also including the HubSpot deal link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345

Next steps I proposed to customer (pending internal approval):
1) Get internal approval by EOD Wed 2026-02-11
2) Share redline-friendly SOW + procurement exception doc with Tom
3) Security sends SOC2 evidence & short answers to their questionnaire
4) DocuSign for pilot SOW once procurement okays exception

Thanks — would appreciate quick guidance on the SLA number and whether we can approve a 20% pilot discount.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: enterprisecorp-procurement-exception-request.pdf, pricing-sheet-v2.xlsx

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 09:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Enterprisecorp stakeholder mapping + procurement timeline

Thanks for the recap, Marissa — good call. A few clarifying / procedural items: 

1) Discount: 20% for a 3-month pilot is aggressive but acceptable if we tie it to clear pilot success criteria (p95 latency & volume). Recommend we require a PO and a short-term SOW with explicit metrics and termination clause.
2) SLA: 99.9% is outside standard for pilots. I'm comfortable approving up to 99.8% for the pilot with the following conditions: (a) we include our standard maintenance windows, (b) a 30-day cure period for incidents before any SLA credits, and (c) automatic fallback to hosted variants if Dedicated suffers capacity issues.
3) Legal/Security: we need security to sign off on the data-retention clause. Can you share the exact language they want? If it's beyond our standard retention, we'll need Legal to approve a contractual exception.

Vivek — can you confirm whether finance can sign off on 20% short-term discount and whether we need Finance exec approval for this deal size (~$45k pilot)? Also confirm whether we can accept a 30-day PO cycle and still hold pricing.

I'll loop in Legal if you confirm SLA tolerance.

- Rishi
SVP Sales

On Wed, Feb 11, 2026 at 08:15 Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Adding Rishi and Vivek for approvals — see below.
>
> > On Tue, Feb 10, 2026 at 3:12 PM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai> wrote:
> > > (call notes...)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Enterprisecorp stakeholder mapping + procurement timeline

Marissa, Rishi — quick note from Finance/Ops side after reviewing the ask and attachments.

- Discount: Finance can approve a one-time 20% pilot discount for deals <= $50k ARR equivalent for up to 3 months, provided there is a signed PO and SOW that prevents retroactive changes. Approving now for this pilot.
- SLA: We can approve 99.8% for the pilot but not 99.9% without sizing the potential credit exposure. Request that Legal review the proposed SLA language and that SRE sign off on the fallback policy.
- Procurement timing: 60-day PO cycles are acceptable; for the pilot, we can accept their 30–45 day internal cycle if they commit to a start date in the contract and provide an initial PO or payment milestone.

Action items from Finance:
1) Marissa — please submit the procurement-exception-request.pdf (attached) into the approvals queue and add a clear definition of pilot success metrics.
2) Rishi — please confirm SLA language you'd like Legal to review (I can escalate if needed).

Vivek
Director, Finance Ops

Hi Sara / Tom —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Quick note to confirm next steps from our side so we can keep to your target pilot start of 2026-04-15: 

1) Internal approval: our Finance & Sales leadership have provisionally approved a 20% pilot discount and a 99.8% pilot SLA pending Legal/security review.
2) I've uploaded the procurement exception request and updated SOW to the shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c
3) Security: our SOC2 report and short questionnaire answers will be sent to your security team by EOD Friday.
4) Procurement: please send the PO template or an initial purchase order to procurement@redwood.ai so we can attach it to the SOW.

Tom — once you send the PO template I will route the formal SOW + DocuSign link for signature. If you prefer, we can also schedule a quick legal/security sync this week to accelerate review.

Thanks — looking forward to getting the pilot started.

Best,
Marissa
